message: `Boxed.grow` needs endless instantiations: `Boxed.grow<T>` calls `Boxed.grow<Boxed<T>>` through `step`, which calls `Boxed.grow<Boxed<Boxed<T>>>`, and so on
fix: where `Boxed.grow` calls itself, call it at its own type parameters: `Boxed.grow<T>`

message: `Wrap.deepen` needs endless instantiations: `Wrap.deepen<T>` calls `Wrap.deepen<Wrap<T>>`, which calls `Wrap.deepen<Wrap<Wrap<T>>>`, and so on
fix: where `Wrap.deepen` calls itself, call it at its own type parameters: `Wrap.deepen<T>`
